## Outcome

What this PR makes true. Link the issue it implements (`#NNN`).

## What changed

The substantive behavioral changes, not a file list. Note any contract,
schema, or operational changes reviewers must not miss.

## Validation

Checks actually run, with results. Distinguish real components
(Postgres, workerd, browser) from mocks and mark gaps explicitly.
Required checks: `agent-rust`, `api-postgres-contracts`, `web-quality`,
`web-edge`.

## Review focus

Where you want substantive review and why. Review notes belong here,
not in chat logs.

## Follow-ups

Known limits and the issues that carry them forward, if any.
